How is Striga hermonthica often recognised in the field?

A. By its blue berries
B. By its large white blooms
C. By its small bright purple-pink flowers
D. It never produces flowers

Answer with the single correct option.
C. By its small bright purple-pink flowers

Crops from which family can add nitrogen to the soil through their root nodules?

A. Legumes (beans, groundnuts, cowpeas)
B. Cereals (grasses)
C. Root crops (cassava)
D. Cucurbits (pumpkin)

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Legumes (beans, groundnuts, cowpeas)

Inoculating bean or soybean seed with Rhizobium improves:

A. Biological nitrogen fixation
B. Photosynthesis rate directly
C. Drought resistance only
D. Seed size at planting

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Biological nitrogen fixation

In an area with a short rainy season, which type of maize variety is generally the safest choice?

A. A very late-maturing variety
B. A variety that needs irrigation
C. Any variety, maturity does not matter
D. An early-maturing variety

Answer with the single correct option.
D. An early-maturing variety
Yaushe ya kamata in shuka masara bisa lokacin damina?

Ka shuka masara a farkon damina, lokacin da qasa ta sami isasshen laima bayan ruwan sama na farko da ya tabbata. Shuka da wuri na ba tsiro damar amfani da dukan ruwan damina da rage illar fari a qarshe. Ka shirya gona da wuri kafin ruwa domin ka iya shuka nan da nan da damina ta fara.

One benefit of using certified or improved seed rather than saved grain is that it usually:

A. Needs no water at all to grow
B. Can never be attacked by any pest
C. Grows well without any sunlight
D. Gives better germination and higher yield potential

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Gives better germination and higher yield potential

In an area with a short rainy season, which crop variety is the safer choice?

A. A short-duration (early-maturing) variety
B. A very long-maturing variety
C. Any variety, because timing does not matter
D. A variety that only grows under irrigation

Answer with the single correct option.
A. A short-duration (early-maturing) variety
Yaya zan hana kwarin da ke lalata hatsi a rumbu?

Ka bushe hatsi sosai kafin adanawa, ka tsaftace rumbu ka cire ragowar hatsin bara. Ka yi amfani da buhunan PICS masu hana iska, ko ka gauraya toka ko ganyen da ke korar kwari da hatsi. Ka riqa dubawa akai-akai, ka fitar da duk hatsin da kwari suka kama don kada su yadu zuwa sauran.

When growing cowpea as a sole crop, why is proper plant spacing important?

A. Crowding closer than recommended always doubles the yield
B. It gives each plant enough room, light and moisture for good pods
C. Spacing only matters for cereal crops
D. Wide random gaps guarantee the best harvest

Answer with the single correct option.
B. It gives each plant enough room, light and moisture for good pods

A common sign of nitrogen deficiency in maize is?

A. Purple leaf edges
B. Bright white new leaves
C. Thickened stems
D. Yellowing of the older, lower leaves

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Yellowing of the older, lower leaves

Which low-cost botanical spray can help a farmer control aphids?

A. Neem extract
B. Kerosene drench
C. Household bleach
D. Battery acid

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Neem extract
My young chickens are passing bloody droppings. What should I do?

Bloody droppings usually mean coccidiosis, common in warm, damp, dirty litter. Treat the whole flock promptly with an anticoccidial such as amprolium in the drinking water for the full course. Keep litter dry and birds not overcrowded, clean waterers daily, and raise feeders and drinkers so droppings don't fall in. Prompt treatment saves most birds.
How dry should my maize be before I store it?

Dry grain to about 13% moisture or lower before storage; damp grain rots and grows mould. Simple tests: dry maize is hard and cracks rather than bends when bitten, and salt shaken in a bottle with the grain will not stick to the sides. Dry on tarpaulins or raised racks in the sun, never on bare ground, and turn it often. Store only clean, fully dry, undamaged grain.

At which stage is maize most sensitive to water shortage (drought stress)?

A. Around flowering (tasseling and silking)
B. Just after germination
C. Only when the grain is fully dry
D. Maize is not sensitive to drought at any stage

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Around flowering (tasseling and silking)

Why is preparing the land before the rains arrive helpful for rain-fed crops?

A. So the field is ready to plant as soon as the rains start
B. It delays planting until after the rains have ended
C. It stops the seeds from ever germinating
D. It is only useful for irrigated fields

Answer with the single correct option.
A. So the field is ready to plant as soon as the rains start

Cassava is valued in drought-prone areas mainly because it:

A. Must be harvested within one week of maturity
B. Tolerates dry conditions and can be left in the ground until needed
C. Needs daily irrigation to survive
D. Only grows in permanently flooded fields

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Tolerates dry conditions and can be left in the ground until needed

Preparing the land before the rains begin is useful mainly because it lets the farmer:

A. Plant promptly as soon as the rains are established
B. Skip planting altogether
C. Remove the need for seed
D. Store the previous harvest more safely

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Plant promptly as soon as the rains are established

What is a common sign that a groundnut crop is ready to harvest?

A. The plants have only just started flowering
B. The leaves start to yellow and the pods are well filled
C. The seed has only just germinated
D. The field is still bright green with no pods

Answer with the single correct option.
B. The leaves start to yellow and the pods are well filled
Wace irin masara zan zaba a yankin da ba ya samun ruwa sosai?

Ka zabi irin masara mai saurin nunawa da jure fari, kamar wanda ke nunawa cikin kwana 90 zuwa 120. Ingantattun iri da aka samo daga amintattun wurare na ba da girbi mafi kyau fiye da irin gargajiya. Ka tuntubi jami'in noma na yankinka domin sanin irin da ya dace da yanayin ku.

Aflatoxin contamination is most commonly a food-safety risk in which stored crops?

A. Lettuce and cabbage
B. Onions and garlic
C. Fresh tomatoes
D. Groundnuts and maize

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Groundnuts and maize

What do climbing (pole) bean varieties need that bush bean varieties do not?

A. No sunlight at all
B. Stakes or other support to climb on
C. To be grown underwater
D. To be planted about 30 cm deep

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Stakes or other support to climb on
We have a short rainy season. Which crops should I plant?

Choose fast-maturing crops and varieties that finish before the rains end. Good options are early beans (60-70 days), cowpeas, sweet potatoes, and short-season maize such as early-maturing or drought-tolerant hybrids. Plant as soon as the rains establish, use all available land, and interplant so one crop uses space while another matures quickly.

To reduce the acidity of a strongly acidic field, a farmer should apply?

A. Urea
B. Muriate of potash
C. Gypsum only
D. Lime

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Lime

Wane sinadari ne ya fi yawa a cikin takin urea?

A. Phosphorus (P)
B. Potassium (K)
C. Sulfur (S)
D. Nitrogen (N)

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Nitrogen (N)

How is the thermostable I-2 Newcastle disease vaccine most commonly given to village chickens?

A. By spraying it on the house floor
B. By adding it to a foot bath
C. Only by a vet injecting it into the heart
D. As an eye drop or in the drinking water

Answer with the single correct option.
D. As an eye drop or in the drinking water
How can I store my grain without using chemicals?

Use hermetic (airtight) storage. Put well-dried grain into a tightly sealed metal drum, airtight container, or hermetic bag and close it fully. Insects inside soon use up the oxygen and die, and none can enter, so no pesticide is needed. Fill the container as full as possible and keep it sealed. The grain must be very dry first, or it will mould.

Yaushe ya fi dacewa a shuka masara a yankin da ya dogara da ruwan sama?

A. Da farkon damina bayan ruwan sama ya tabbata
B. A tsakiyar lokacin rani
C. A karshen damina
D. Duk lokacin da manomi ya so ba tare da la'akari da ruwa ba

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Da farkon damina bayan ruwan sama ya tabbata
Nihifadhi vipi mahindi baada ya kuvuna ili yasiharibike?

Kausha mahindi vizuri hadi yafikie unyevu wa asilimia 13 au chini kabla ya kuhifadhi. Tumia magunia ya kisasa ya PICS au vihenge safi na vikavu. Weka mahindi mahali pakavu penye mzunguko mzuri wa hewa, na kagua mara kwa mara ili kuzuia wadudu waharibifu na ukungu unaozalisha sumu ya aflatoksini.
Yaya zan kare kajina daga cutar Newcastle?

Cutar Newcastle na yaduwa da sauri kuma tana kashe kaji da yawa. Hanya mafi kyau ita ce yin allurar riga-kafi: ka yi wa kananan kaji allura tun suna qanana, ka maimaita kowane wata uku zuwa hudu. Ka ware kajin da suka kamu nan da nan, ka tsaftace gidansu, kada ka gauraya sababbin kaji da tsofaffi ba tare da ware su ba.

Magonjwa yanayoenezwa na kupe kwa ng'ombe huzuiwaje?

A. Kwa kuogesha au kunyunyiza ng'ombe dawa ya kupe mara kwa mara
B. Kwa kuwapa ng'ombe chumvi nyingi
C. Kwa kuwaacha ng'ombe malishoni muda mrefu
D. Kwa kuwanywesha ng'ombe maji mengi

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Kwa kuogesha au kunyunyiza ng'ombe dawa ya kupe mara kwa mara

Katika maeneo kame yenye mvua kidogo, ni zao gani linalofaa zaidi kupanda?

A. Mpunga wa kwenye maji
B. Mtama au uwele (sorghum au millet)
C. Migomba ya ndizi
D. Mboga za majani zinazohitaji maji mengi

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Mtama au uwele (sorghum au millet)
Weevils destroy my stored beans. How do I keep them safe?

Those are bruchids (bean weevils) that begin in the field. Dry the beans well, then store them airtight in a sealed bottle, drum, or hermetic bag so the pests suffocate. Coating the seed with a little cooking oil or wood ash stops egg-laying. Sun-heating or briefly freezing the beans before sealing kills eggs already present. Remove any infested beans first.

Wane sinadari ne ke fi taimakawa girman ganye da kore-koren tsiro?

A. Phosphorus (P)
B. Potassium (K)
C. Nitrogen (N)
D. Calcium (Ca)

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Nitrogen (N)

Ni dalili gani za ugonjwa wa mdondo (Newcastle) kwa kuku?

A. Kuku kunenepa haraka na kutaga mayai mengi
B. Manyoya kung'aa zaidi
C. Kuku kula chakula kingi kuliko kawaida
D. Kupooza, kupinda shingo, kuharisha kijani na vifo vya ghafla vingi

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Kupooza, kupinda shingo, kuharisha kijani na vifo vya ghafla vingi

Why do many smallholders intercrop maize with a legume such as cowpea or beans?

A. Legumes kill the maize plants
B. It makes both crops fail
C. It can improve soil fertility and give two harvests from one field
D. Maize cannot grow near any other plant

Answer with the single correct option.
C. It can improve soil fertility and give two harvests from one field

Agricultural lime is applied to a field mainly to?

A. Lower soil pH (make it more acidic)
B. Raise soil pH (reduce acidity)
C. Add nitrogen quickly
D. Kill weeds

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Raise soil pH (reduce acidity)

Muriate of potash (MOP) is applied mainly to supply which nutrient?

A. Nitrogen
B. Potassium
C. Phosphorus
D. Calcium

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Potassium

In push-pull for stemborer and fall armyworm control, which crop is used as the border 'pull' (trap) plant?

A. Maize
B. Cassava
C. Sweet potato
D. Napier (elephant) grass

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Napier (elephant) grass

Why is even, recommended spacing important when planting groundnuts?

A. Good spacing reduces competition and helps pods develop well
B. Crowded plants always give bigger nuts
C. Spacing does not matter for groundnuts
D. Wide random gaps guarantee more nuts

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Good spacing reduces competition and helps pods develop well

Groundnut rosette disease is spread from plant to plant mainly by:

A. Whiteflies
B. Slugs
C. Aphids
D. Termites

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Aphids

For rain-fed smallholder maize with one plant per station, what row and in-row spacing is generally recommended?

A. 75 cm between rows and 25 cm within the row
B. 30 cm between rows and 30 cm within the row
C. 120 cm between rows and 60 cm within the row
D. 45 cm between rows and 10 cm within the row

Answer with the single correct option.
A. 75 cm between rows and 25 cm within the row

Why is it important to thin sorghum to the recommended plant spacing?

A. Overcrowded plants always yield more
B. Plant spacing has no effect on sorghum
C. Too many plants compete and produce small heads
D. Wider gaps stop the plants from flowering

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Too many plants compete and produce small heads

The main purpose of testing soil before planting is to?

A. Predict the weather
B. Find out nutrient levels and pH to guide fertilizer use
C. Decide market prices
D. Measure the field size

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Find out nutrient levels and pH to guide fertilizer use

Maize streak virus is transmitted from plant to plant mainly by:

A. Rainfall splash
B. Leafhoppers
C. Contaminated tools
D. Wind alone

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Leafhoppers
Birds are eating my sorghum before harvest. What can I do?

Bird damage is worst as the grain ripens. Plant your sorghum at the same time as neighbours so no single field is the only target, and choose varieties with tight heads or a bitter tannin coat that birds avoid. Scare birds actively during grain filling using guards, reflective tape, or noise, especially in early morning and evening. Harvest promptly once mature to cut losses.

The fertilizer known as 'DAP' stands for?

A. Double ammonium phosphate
B. Dry ammonium potash
C. Di-ammonium phosphate
D. Diluted acid phosphate

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Di-ammonium phosphate

Wanne mataki ne ke rage cututtukan da kaska ke yadawa a shanu?

A. Kara yawan kaska a jikin shanu
B. Barin shanu su kwana a wuri mai laka
C. Wanke shanu da maganin kashe kaska (acaricide) akai-akai
D. Rage ba wa shanu abinci

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Wanke shanu da maganin kashe kaska (acaricide) akai-akai

Foot-and-mouth disease in cattle is best described as which of the following?

A. A vitamin deficiency cured by minerals
B. A parasite spread only by mosquitoes
C. A highly contagious viral disease causing blisters in the mouth and on the feet
D. A fungus that grows on hooves in dry weather

Answer with the single correct option.
C. A highly contagious viral disease causing blisters in the mouth and on the feet
What are cover crops and how do they help my soil?

Cover crops are plants grown to protect and improve the soil rather than for harvest, such as lablab, mucuna, or cowpea. They shade the ground to stop erosion and weeds, and legume covers add nitrogen. When dug in or left as mulch, they add organic matter that improves moisture holding and structure. Grow them in the off-season or between rows, then cut and incorporate before they seed.

Kwa nini kupanda mikunde kama maharagwe na kunde husaidia udongo?

A. Hurutubisha udongo kwa kufunga naitrojeni kutoka hewani
B. Hukausha udongo haraka
C. Huongeza tindikali ya udongo
D. Huvuta wadudu waharibifu

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Hurutubisha udongo kwa kufunga naitrojeni kutoka hewani

Mahindi yanapaswa kukaushwa hadi kiwango gani cha unyevu kabla ya kuhifadhi ili kuepuka kuoza?

A. Asilimia 25 hadi 30
B. Asilimia 20
C. Asilimia 13 au chini yake
D. Unyevu haujalishi wakati wa kuhifadhi

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Asilimia 13 au chini yake
Nidhibiti vipi viwavijeshi wanaoshambulia mahindi yangu?

Kagua shamba mara kwa mara, hasa kilele cha mmea ambapo viwavijeshi hujificha. Okota na uue mayai na viwavi kwa mkono ikiwa shamba ni dogo. Weka mchanga au majivu kwenye kitovu cha mmea, na tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa pale mashambulizi yanapozidi kiwango. Panda mapema na fanya mzunguko wa mazao ili kupunguza tatizo.

Ta yaya manomi zai rage yaduwar cutar mosaic ta rogo?

A. Daukar rassan dasa daga tsirran da suka kamu da cuta
B. Zuba taki mai yawa a gona
C. Shuka rogo a zurfi sosai
D. Amfani da bishiyoyin dasa marasa cuta (clean cuttings) da shuka nau'in da ke jure cutar

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Amfani da bishiyoyin dasa marasa cuta (clean cuttings) da shuka nau'in da ke jure cutar

Ugonjwa wa mdondo (Newcastle) kwa kuku huzuiwaje kwa ufanisi?

A. Kwa kuwapa kuku maji ya chumvi
B. Kwa kuwanyweshea kuku maziwa
C. Kwa kuchanja kuku chanjo ya mdondo mara kwa mara
D. Kwa kuwapa kuku dawa za minyoo pekee

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Kwa kuchanja kuku chanjo ya mdondo mara kwa mara

Aflatoxins in stored maize and groundnuts are produced by which organism?

A. Rhizobium bacteria
B. The water mould Phytophthora infestans
C. The fungus Aspergillus flavus
D. A leaf-eating caterpillar

Answer with the single correct option.
C. The fungus Aspergillus flavus
Is it safe to apply fertilizer when the soil is dry?

Applying fertilizer to dry soil wastes it, because the nutrients cannot dissolve and reach the roots, and nitrogen can be lost. Apply just before or after rain, or when the soil is moist, and work it lightly into the soil rather than leaving it on the surface. Avoid placing fertilizer directly touching seeds or stems, as it can burn them. Keep a few centimetres of gap from the plant.

Because sorghum seed is small, how deep should it usually be planted?

A. Very deep, about 15 cm
B. Shallow, about 2-5 cm deep
C. Buried about 20 cm below the surface
D. Left on top of the soil, uncovered

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Shallow, about 2-5 cm deep

Wane zurfi ne ya dace a shuka irin masara?

A. Kimanin 20 cm a cikin kasa
B. A saman kasa kawai ba tare da rufewa ba
C. Kimanin 3 zuwa 5 cm a cikin kasa
D. Kimanin 15 cm a cikin kasa

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Kimanin 3 zuwa 5 cm a cikin kasa

Menene babban amfanin takin DAP ga tsirrai?

A. Yana samar da phosphorus da nitrogen, mai kyau don shuka da bunkasa tushe
B. Yana kashe kwari a gona
C. Yana rage yawan amfanin gona
D. Yana maganin cutar ganye

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Yana samar da phosphorus da nitrogen, mai kyau don shuka da bunkasa tushe

Mulching the soil surface conserves moisture mainly by?

A. Increasing evaporation
B. Heating the soil
C. Reducing evaporation from the soil
D. Blocking rainfall completely

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Reducing evaporation from the soil

Striga seeds in the soil are triggered to germinate mainly by:

A. Cold night temperatures
B. Bright moonlight
C. Chemical signals released by host crop roots
D. Salty soil

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Chemical signals released by host crop roots
How do I know when my maize is ready to harvest?

Maize for dry grain is ready when the husks turn brown and dry and the kernels are hard and dented, with a black layer at the kernel base. Test by pressing a kernel with your nail; if it does not dent, it is dry enough. Harvest promptly in dry weather to avoid mould and pest damage in the field, then dry the cobs further before shelling and storing.
How do I store my potatoes so they last longer?

First cure them: keep tubers 1-2 weeks in a shaded, airy place so the skins toughen. Then store only sound, undamaged tubers in a cool, dark, well-ventilated spot on a raised slatted floor, not a sealed sack. Keep them out of light so they don't turn green, since green parts are toxic. Check often and remove any rotting tubers quickly.
Is zero-grazing better than letting my cattle roam?

On a small plot, zero-grazing (cut-and-carry) often works better. You bring fodder to a shed, so you use less land, control ticks and disease more easily, and collect manure and urine for crops. Build a dry, well-ventilated shed with a raised slatted floor. It suits improved dairy breeds, while free grazing suits large open rangeland.

Planting maize too early, before the rains are properly established, is risky because:

A. The seed becomes poisonous
B. The soil becomes too fertile
C. Weeds can no longer grow
D. Seedlings may die if a dry spell follows germination

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Seedlings may die if a dry spell follows germination
How do I know the rains are truly established before planting?

Don't rush in after the first shower. Wait for an effective onset: about 20mm or more of rainfall over a couple of days that wets the soil at least 20cm deep, then continued rains in the following weeks. Planting early can mean crop failure; planting too late shortens the season. Follow local advice and use a short-season variety if planting late.

Bean anthracnose typically shows on the crop as:

A. Silver-coloured leaves
B. Dark sunken spots (lesions) on pods and stems
C. Blue pods
D. Fluffy white roots

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Dark sunken spots (lesions) on pods and stems

Ta yaya legumes kamar wake ke kara nitrogen a cikin kasa?

A. Ta hanyar shan ruwan sama mai yawa
B. Ta hanyar zubar da ganye kadai
C. Ta hanyar kwayoyin rhizobia da ke kama nitrogen daga iska a cikin kumburin tushe
D. Ba sa kara nitrogen kwata-kwata

Answer with the single correct option.
C. Ta hanyar kwayoyin rhizobia da ke kama nitrogen daga iska a cikin kumburin tushe
My cassava leaves have yellow blotches and the roots are rotting with brown streaks. What is it?

This looks like cassava brown streak disease, spread by whiteflies and infected cuttings. The roots develop a brown, corky rot that makes them unusable, and there is no cure. Uproot and destroy affected plants, plant only clean cuttings from healthy plants or tolerant varieties from your extension office, and harvest early before the rot spreads.

Why is transplanting rice in regular rows and spacing better than scattering seedlings randomly?

A. It makes weeding easier and gives plants even room to grow
B. It makes weeding much harder
C. It uses far more seed
D. Random planting always yields more

Answer with the single correct option.
A. It makes weeding easier and gives plants even room to grow
Ta yaya zan shuka masara don samun kyakkyawan girbi?

Ka shuka masara da tazara ta santimita 75 tsakanin layuka da santimita 25 tsakanin tsirrai, ka sa iri daya ko biyu a kowace rami. Wannan tazara na ba tsirrai damar samun isasshen haske, ruwa da abinci mai gina jiki, kuma yana sauqaqa noman ciyawa. Ka tabbata qasa tana da isasshen laima lokacin shuka.

What is an advantage of planting maize in rows compared with scattering (broadcasting) the seed?

A. It always uses much more seed
B. It makes weeding, spacing and harvesting easier to manage
C. It prevents the maize from producing cobs
D. Row planting is only possible with machines

Answer with the single correct option.
B. It makes weeding, spacing and harvesting easier to manage
How should I space and plant my beans for a good harvest?

Plant beans at the onset of steady rains in well-drained soil. Space rows about 40 to 50 cm apart with 10 cm between plants, sowing seeds 3 to 5 cm deep, one to two per hole. Use certified, disease-free seed, weed early, and rotate with cereals like maize to reduce root diseases. Avoid waterlogged spots, as they cause the seeds and roots to rot.
Nidhibiti vipi magugu ya kiduha (striga) yanayoshambulia mahindi?

Kiduha hunyonya virutubisho kutoka mizizi ya mahindi na kupunguza mavuno sana. Dhibiti kwa kupanda mikunde kwa mzunguko, kuongeza mbolea za asili na naitrojeni, na kung'oa magugu kabla hayajatoa mbegu. Kupanda aina zinazostahimili kiduha na kuchanganya na soya au maharagwe husaidia kupunguza tatizo.

When should a farmer scout maize for fall armyworm?

A. Only after harvest
B. Regularly, starting from the seedling stage
C. Only once the crop is flowering
D. Scouting is not needed

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Regularly, starting from the seedling stage

Which practice best reduces late blight in potato and tomato?

A. Removing and destroying infected plants and using resistant varieties
B. Watering the leaves heavily every evening
C. Planting in the wettest, most shaded corner
D. Never rotating the crop

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Removing and destroying infected plants and using resistant varieties

Roughly how long after planting is cassava usually ready for harvest?

A. About 2 weeks
B. Around 9-12 months or more, depending on the variety
C. About 3-4 weeks
D. Only a few days after planting

Answer with the single correct option.
B. Around 9-12 months or more, depending on the variety
Why does water pool and my crops still dry out? How do I help rain soak in?

Bare, crusted soil sheds water instead of absorbing it. Break the crust by light tilling, and dig planting pits or contour furrows across the slope to slow runoff so it soaks in. Add manure, compost, or mulch to open the soil and hold moisture. On slopes, plant grass strips or bunds along the contour to stop water and soil running off.

Which nutrient helps crops resist drought and disease by regulating water use?

A. Potassium (K)
B. Nitrogen (N)
C. Phosphorus (P)
D. Sulphur (S)

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Potassium (K)

Zuwa wane matakin danshi ya kamata a bushe masara kafin ajiya mai aminci?

A. Kimanin 13% danshi ko kasa da haka
B. Kimanin 30% danshi
C. Kimanin 50% danshi
D. Babu bukatar bushewa kwata-kwata

Answer with the single correct option.
A. Kimanin 13% danshi ko kasa da haka
My tomato leaves are curling and the plants are stunted. What is wrong?

Upward leaf curling with stunting is often caused by whitefly-spread viruses. Whiteflies must be controlled early: use yellow sticky traps, remove and destroy infected plants, and keep the field free of weeds that host them. A silver or reflective mulch repels whiteflies. Grow resistant varieties where available, and avoid planting new tomatoes next to old infected ones.

For best results, rice seedlings are usually transplanted while they are still:

A. Fully mature and flowering
B. Dry and dead
C. Already carrying grain
D. Young, a few weeks old

Answer with the single correct option.
D. Young, a few weeks old

On which part of the plant do you look to spot cassava mosaic disease?

A. Yellow-green mosaic patches and distortion on the leaves

How do I plant sweet potato vines for a good root harvest?

How can I improve a tired field that gives poor yields every year?

Rebuild it by adding compost or well-rotted manure, rotating in legumes like beans or cowpea that fix nitrogen, and returning crop residues instead of burning them. What is the vaccination schedule to protect my chickens from Newcastle disease?

Use the heat-tolerant I-2 Newcastle vaccine as an eye drop. Vaccinate chicks at about 2-3 weeks, repeat at 3-4 weeks, then boost every 3-4 months, ideally before dry-season outbreaks. Vaccinate only healthy birds, keep the vaccine cold in a flask with ice, and use it the same day. Vaccination prevents the disease but cannot cure already-sick birds.
How do I keep young chicks alive in their first weeks?

Chicks cannot control their body heat, so keep them warm: about 35C in week one, lowering roughly 3C each week until they feather. Watch them: huddling means too cold, spreading to the edges means too hot. Give clean warm water and chick starter or fine mash, keep bedding dry, and protect them from rats, cold drafts, and damp.

Aphids are covering my vegetable plants. How do I get rid of them without expensive chemicals?

Remove heavily infested shoots. Check plants often, as early action stops a small problem becoming large.
